maailma — selection benchmark vs Reuters DNR

generated 2026-08-31T23:56:36 from data/sources.csv · 198 countries · top-10 selection per country · DNR overlap 61/110
✓ native feed on the outlet's own site (linked) ✓ alternative feed = Google-News rescue (linked) ? feed URL found but not serving entries ✓ outlet matches a Reuters DNR brand ✗ outlet is not on the DNR reference n/m DNR reference brands present in our top-10
What the columns mean
Feed
Feed availability — the feed parser's result, so it is clear which outlets were actually added to the digest pool. ✓ = a native feed was discovered on the outlet's own site AND it serves parseable entries (link opens the feed). ? = a feed URL was found but is not currently serving. — = no native feed.
Alt feed
Alternative feed — the Google-News site-scoped RSS used when an outlet exposes no native feed (an aggregator dependency, not the outlet's own channel). Link opens the feed; the checkmark means it is serving.
DNR
Reuters DNR reference match as a boolean: ✓ = this outlet is a DNR brand for the market, ✗ = it is not. Calibration/test metric — the full top-10 list should mostly match the DNR list (test criteria: recall@10 ≥ 3 of 5 per market).
Score
Composite ranking score = 0.39·Reach + 0.33·Language + 0.28·Consensus (weights in config.HEURISTIC_WEIGHTS). Liveness (feed availability) is excluded — it is the eligibility flag, not a ranking term. The reach term is log1p-saturated.
Reach
Audience breadth proxy: log-normalized Wikipedia pageviews (English + up to 2 local editions), strongest edition wins, scaled by in-country language audience share. 1.0 = most-viewed outlet in the country.
Lang
Language match: 1.0 official/de-facto language, else 0.5.
Consensus
Share of active discovery sources that surfaced the outlet.
Liveness
Feed availability score (eligibility flag, weight 0.00): 0.5 feed reachable + parseable, +0.25 HTTPS, +0.25 recent (<7d) entries, 0.0 no usable feed.

The reference is tests/fixtures/dnr_ground_truth.json (Reuters Institute DNR top online brands) — only those markets carry a DNR comparison. Each row is one of the top-10 outlets per country ranked by the final score — the exact list the digest pool ingests — with the feed parser's result (native + alternative feed) so it is clear what was actually added to the pool. Rows for benchmark markets come from python -m tests.benchmark_analysis; the cross-market improvement/reasoning layer is the separate analysis_report.html — regenerate via python -m scripts.analysis_report. Regenerate this page — python -m tests.render_benchmark — after every rank run; tests/test_benchmark_html.py enforces freshness.
